name: twobit
description: The genome in UCSC's .2bit format, for the tools that read it that way: deepTools, BLAT, rtracklayer. DERIVED from the vault's own FASTA with faToTwoBit by bin/derive_twobit.sh, which then reads the names and lengths back out of the .2bit and refuses it unless they are the genome's own. Soft-masking is kept: lower-case sequence in the FASTA is masked in the .2bit. The fasta asset is recorded as the parent.

required_files.description: the .2bit file written by the DERIVE_TWOBIT process
